d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : ek shadi men ghurdaur jitne vale ko milne vali hai thar.... varmala ke lie banaya ja raha hai 100 phit lanba aur 35 phit ooncha stej.... sajavat ke lie chin se khas phul mangvae ja rahe hain.... aur mehmanon ki khatirdari ke lie char lakh logon ke khane ka intjam kiya ja raha hai....ab jara sochie jab shadi ka ek-ek intjam itna shahi hai, to barat ka svagat aur dulha-dulhan ki entri kaisi hone vali hogi.... aakhir bihar men kiski shadi ke lie pani ki tarah paisa bahaya ja raha hai.... aur kyon is shadi ki charcha abhi se pure ilake men hone lagi hai.... to…
